title: local-gateway-19001-buildinfo-fix
goal: Fix gateway :19001 missing build-info identity gap by restarting from git worktree with official write-build-info
authorizedApproach: proper restart of acceptance gateway only (not production / not :18789/:18790)

stop.signal: TERM then verify; KILL not needed

restart.command: OPENCLAW_SKIP_CHANNELS=1 CLAWDBOT_SKIP_CHANNELS=1 OPENBOT_STATE_DIR=/private/tmp/openbot-joint-accept-state-883a5159 OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/private/tmp/openbot-joint-accept-state-883a5159 OPENBOT_GATEWAY_PORT=19001 nohup node scripts/run-node.mjs --dev gateway --port 19001 > /private/tmp/openbot-joint-accept-19001-restart.log 2>&1 &
restart.runNodeNote: run-node.mjs rebuilt stale TypeScript dist and auto-built Control UI assets on first start; write-build-info alone was run first and commit identity survived

notes: No full pnpm build invoked manually; run-node --dev performed stale dist rebuild + ui:build automatically.

Gateway log noted auth token was missing and generated a new token saved to state config (gateway.auth.token); openbot.json rewritten with backup .bak — token value intentionally omitted from this evidence.
No git commit/push of evidence; file written for user to push later.
Did not touch production ports :18789 or :18790.
